question: What is the stone-like disc seen at the top of the temple in Odisha and nearby district's Temple architecture called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amalaka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amalaka

 
 
• It is a stone disc-like structure at the top of the temple.
 
• they are common in North Indian temples.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kalasha **is a sacred pot or **urn at the top of a temple's central spire.**
 
• **Antarala **is the space between the **Garbhagriha and mandapa of a temple, serving as a transition area.**
 
• **Jagati **is a raised platform made of stone on which a temple is built, **representing the sacred mountain or Meru in Hindu mythology**.
 
 
• These three architectural features are common in Hindu temples, including **Odisha**.
